title: Prepare for Australian rural isolation
intro: Australian sources for isolated properties, animals, communications and basic remote travel preparation. NSW farm rules and service contacts apply to NSW; route-specific remote travel coverage remains incomplete. South Australian readings retain SA contacts and requirements; they are not national rules.
